plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Major performance improvement: persistent YoutubeDL instance and persistent Node worker reduce per-track extraction from ~10s to ~6s. Pre-warmup on startup so first song benefits too. Persistent Node worker with V8 JIT reduces JS challenge solving from 2.5s to ~100ms.
plugin.creator: schmij97
